intro: Lesson 114: Revision: P6 magnetism and electromagnetism. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: (a) Draw the field around a single bar magnet [2]. (b) Describe how to use a plotting compass to find the field pattern [2]. (c) A magnet is pushed into a coil connected to a meter. Describe and explain the meter reading when the magnet is pushed in, held still, and pulled out [3].
questions.a: (a) lines N to S, curved, not crossing, arrows (2); (b) place compass at N pole, mark needle direction, move along, join dots (2); (c) pushed in: deflection (1); still: zero, no change in field (1); pulled out: opposite deflection (1)
questions.model: Teacher draws the bar magnet and the first field line with an arrow.

questions.q: Explain why the coil of a d.c. motor rotates continuously in one direction.
questions.a: Forces on opposite sides act in opposite directions, giving a turning effect (1); split-ring commutator reverses current every half turn (1), keeping the force in the same rotational sense (1)

questions.q: Why does a bicycle dynamo light dim when you ride slowly?
questions.a: Slower rotation cuts field lines more slowly, inducing a smaller voltage.

questions.q: Explain how a loudspeaker produces sound.
questions.a: Alternating current in the coil in a magnetic field (1); force on coil changes direction (motor effect) (1); cone vibrates, making pressure waves (sound) (1)
questions.model: Current in a field gives a force. Alternating current reverses the force many times a second. The cone vibrates: sound.

questions.q: State two ways to increase the induced voltage in a generator.
questions.a: Rotate faster; stronger magnet; more turns on the coil

questions.q: Why is iron used in an electromagnet core?
questions.a: It is magnetically soft: magnetises strongly and demagnetises when switched off
